title: Senior Product Designer
description: SumUp | Product & Design | London, United Kingdom Competitive salary · Office-first This role does not support Visa sponsorship and candidates must have the right to work in the UK. About the team The Consumer Bank squad sits at the heart of one of SumUp's most exciting growth bets — scaling SumUp Pay, our consumer fintech product, to millions of active users across Europe. The team owns end-to-end UX and product design across the full user lifecycle, from onboarding and activation through to engagement features like Spaces, Open Banking insights, and budget tracking. This is a high-craft, high-autonomy environment where design isn't just execution — it's central to defining the problems worth solving, and your work will directly shape adoption, retention, and the future of SumUp's consumer offering. What you'll do Own end-to-end product design within the Consumer Bank squad, from discovery through to delivery, across the SumUp Pay mobile experience Lead discovery by identifying user problems, framing opportunities, and shaping hypotheses alongside Product and Engineering Design intuitive, high-quality mobile experiences in Figma that drive key metrics including activation, engagement, and retention Validate solutions through prototyping, user research, and usability testing, using both qualitative and quantitative data to iterate Contribute to the design system and help maintain consistency and quality across the product as SumUp scales its consumer offering You'll be great for this role if… Proven experience as a Senior Product Designer working on mobile-first consumer products, with a portfolio demonstrating end-to-end UX design and measurable impact Strong discovery skills, including problem framing, hypothesis definition, user research, and insight synthesis Excellent UX, interaction, and information design skills, with a high bar for quality and usability Comfort working autonomously within cross-functional teams alongside Product Managers and Engineers, with solid understanding of technical constraints Ability to leverage AI design tools (e.g. for ideation, prototyping, and research synthesis) to accelerate workflows and elevate the quality of outcomes Proficiency in Figma and experience contributing to or evolving design systems Why you should join SumUp 🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our central London Bridge location. This involves an office-first setup 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success 🏖️ Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave, plus bank holidays and special leaves 🏥 Health matters: private health insurance, including optical and dental 🚗 Life made easier: salary-sacrifice commuter benefits via Gogeta 💼 Financial security: retirement scheme (SumUp matches 7% when you contribute 5%) 🛡️ Peace of mind: life insurance from MetLife for 2× your salary 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service 🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team About SumUp Be empowered to do more that matters. At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships. Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify. SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website , and follow our journey on LinkedIn , Instagram , and 🎬 Want to see more of life at SumUp? Explore our Global Employer Brand video library to add to your job post or create LinkedIn posts. title: Senior Associate, GTM Marketing
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. As Senior Associate, GTM Marketing, you'll partner with product, S&O and other stakeholders to bring launches to market, owning full-funnel, multi-channel campaigns for specific product lines or business segments. You'll turn complex product capabilities into clear messaging, compelling content and go-to-market strategies, and use data to track performance, optimise user acquisition and measure ROI. What you'll do Coordinate launches: Partner with product, S&O and marketing, acting as the central point of coordination for campaign delivery. Your focus will be GTM activity in the marketing space. Own delivery: Run campaign plans from briefing to launch, tracking milestones, dependencies and deadlines across multiple campaigns at once. Spot risks early and hold stakeholders accountable for their actions. Communicate clearly: Turn plans into clear, actionable updates for commercial teams, and build and run merchant communication plans, including email campaigns, sign-up reminders and operational guidance. Enable sales: Create high-quality sell-in materials such as Google Slides decks, email templates and campaign toolkits. Build landing pages on the Partner Website and make sure all assets are accurate, on-brand and hosted on Seismic ahead of launch. Manage stakeholders: Build strong relationships across marketing, commercial and cross-functional teams. Influence them to involve GTM early, challenge timelines constructively and keep everyone aligned through regular check-ins. Keep improving: Support post-launch evaluations and find ways to improve GTM content, processes and how marketing and commercial teams work together. About you Essential Product marketing experience at a fast-paced company Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation and influencing skills Exceptional written and verbal communication, able to tailor messaging for different audiences Experience managing multiple cross-functional projects in parallel Highly organised with strong attention to detail, and comfortable with ambiguity A creative mindset with an eye for design and engaging content Nice to have Experience in GTM, commercial or marketing functions Experience with merchant or partner communications Experience building landing pages using a website content management system Familiarity with Seismic or similar sales enablement platforms Why Join Us? At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to: 🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders. 🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility. 🧠 Build a career, not just a role Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves. 🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best. We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here . Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief. If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience. If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you! Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness . title: Security Engineer III
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.</p> <p>What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating<em> </em>our wins – big and small.</p> <p>Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, <a href="https://www.anaplan.com/careers/">values</a>-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!</p></div><p><strong>What you’ll be doing:</strong></p> <p>As a Security Engineer within the Security Operations team, you will help design, build, and continuously improve the technical capabilities that underpin how we detect, investigate, and respond to threats. You will work at the intersection of engineering and operations — helping turn security problems into scalable, automated solutions. Your core responsibilities will be to:</p> <ul> <li>Alert Investigation & Triage: Investigate and triage security alerts from across our detection tooling, analysing logs, endpoint, identity, cloud, and network telemetry to determine impact and root cause. Work alongside the wider SOC to escalate and resolve confirmed threats, document findings clearly, and feed what you learn back into detections, tuning, and automation.</li> <li>Incident Response & DFIR: Support the investigation and response to confirmed security incidents, applying digital forensics and incident response skills across endpoint, cloud, and identity data. Help with evidence collection and preservation, timeline reconstruction, containment, and root cause analysis, and contribute to post-incident reviews that turn lessons learned into improved detections and tooling.</li> <li>SIEM Engineering: Contribute to the engineering of our SIEM platform, including onboarding and normalising log sources, building and maintaining parsers, and supporting high-fidelity data pipelines that underpin detection and investigation. Help improve log coverage, data quality, and platform performance.</li> <li>Detection Engineering: Help develop and maintain a library of high-quality detections using a Detection as Code methodology — working with version control, peer review, and automated testing pipelines. Map detections to the MITRE ATT&CK framework and contribute to improving coverage, precision, and resilience against evasion.</li> <li>AI-Augmented Security Operations: Help explore and apply AI and machine learning to enhance security operations capabilities — including alert triage, incident response acceleration, threat intelligence analysis, threat hunting, and the enrichment and prioritisation of detection content. Contribute to evaluating emerging AI tooling and embedding it responsibly into team workflows.</li> <li>Threat Intelligence Integration: Help consume and operationalise threat intelligence from internal and external sources, integrating indicators and adversary context into detection logic, response playbooks, and hunting activities. Work with threat intelligence feeds and platforms to support a timely and structured flow of actionable intelligence into security operations.</li> <li>Threat Hunting: Take part in proactive, hypothesis-driven threat hunts across the environment to identify attacker activity that evades existing detections. Document and share findings in a structured way, using hunt outcomes to inform and improve detection engineering and tooling.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring to the role:</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a technically capable security professional with hands-on experience in security operations. The ideal candidate will possess:</p> <ul> <li>Technical Security Experience: commercial experience in a security operations role, with a solid grounding in securing cloud-native environments and modern application stacks.</li> <li>Incident Response & Digital Forensics: Hands-on experience supporting security incident investigations, including evidence preservation, log and artifact analysis, timeline reconstruction, and root cause identification. Familiarity with forensic tooling and methodologies is highly sought after, as is experience contributing to post-incident reviews and translating findings into actionable improvements.</li> <li>Detection & Response Skills: Practical experience developing and tuning SIEM detections, writing threat hunting queries, and participating in incident response activities.</li> <li>SecOps Tooling: Hands-on knowledge of administering and operating core security operations tools, including SIEM platforms, EDR/XDR solutions, vulnerability scanners, and ticketing or case management systems. Experience integrating these tools to support detection, investigation, and response workflows.</li> <li>Threat Intelligence & Threat Hunting: Experience working with threat intelligence platforms and feeds, and integrating intelligence into security tooling, detection logic, and operational processes. A working knowledge of threat hunting methodologies and the ability to proactively identify indicators of compromise or attacker behaviour across the environment is highly desirable.</li> <li>Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in one or more scripting or programming languages (e.g. Python, Go, Bash) to build security tooling, automate workflows, and integrate security capabilities.</li> <li>Application Security Knowledge: Familiarity with secure development practices, OWASP top risks, and the ability to perform code reviews or work with developers to remediate security findings.</li> <li>Security Frameworks & Standards: Working knowledge of relevant security frameworks (e.g. NIST CSF, CIS Benchmarks, MITRE ATT&CK) and compliance standards such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001.</li> <li>Communication & Collaboration: Strong ability to articulate technical security risks and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and to work cross-functionally to deliver security outcomes.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) </strong></p> <p>We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! </p> <p>We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  </p> <p><strong>Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer</strong>  </p> <p>It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals. </p> <p>Anaplan does not:  </p> <ul> <li>Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.  </li> <li>Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  </li> </ul> <p>All emails from Anaplan would come from an ----- email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to ----- before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.  </p> <p><strong><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW36347262 BCX0">Privacy & AI</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW36347262 BCX0"> Notice</span></strong></p> <p><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">C</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">andidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">in accordance with</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0"> our <a href="https://www.anaplan.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice/">Candidate Privacy Notice</a>. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0">assist</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW238761408 BCX0"> our team in evaluating qualifications.</span></p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Trade Marketing Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About Us</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":0,"335559739":280}"> </span></p> <p>SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. <strong>Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja</strong>, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world. </p> <p><strong>AI at SharkNinja </strong></p> <p>At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>We are a social-first business, revolutionising how retail marketing is approached, and we are looking for a Senior Retail (Trade) Marketing Manager to lead our Pureplay vertical across the UK & ROI. Leading a team across our five pureplay retail channels, all three of our brands (Shark, Shark Beauty and Ninja) and a portfolio of 39 product categories, you will own Retail Media Planning and Trade Marketing Strategy for the vertical, bring a sharp commercial lens to everything we do, be our senior marketing relationship for the retailers, and partner closely with Sales and the wider marketing community to unlock growth. Social-first collaboration is a growing and exciting part of the remit. If it is not yet your strength, we will help you build it.</p> <p><strong>Here are some of the EXCITING things you’ll get to do:</strong></p> <p><strong>Strategy & Planning</strong></p> <p>• Lead the Pureplay vertical against ambitious growth targets, owning the number and advising the business on how that growth will be unlocked across retail media and trade marketing.</p> <p>• Lead Retail Media and Trade Marketing strategy and planning for the vertical across the full marketing funnel: setting the standard for what good looks like, guiding your team’s planning, calendar and prioritisation, aligning UKI execution with global objectives, and deploying investment where it drives the strongest commercial return.</p> <p>• Be the senior, retailer-facing marketing lead for the vertical, building and progressively deepening relationships with the senior marketing contacts within your retailers, and using them to shape joint plans, unlock opportunities and position SharkNinja as a priority partner.</p> <p>• Act as the sense-check on the viability of what the Strategy, Sales & Analytics (SSnA) and Sales teams propose: probing, collaborating and keeping a helicopter view to ensure full-funnel plans (including promotional and launch events across the year) are joined up, deliver the commercial volume objectives set by SSnA, align to the SKUs and volumes secured by Sales, and keep marketing investment where it needs to be. Develop and own the digital-channel Joint Business Plans with Sales.</p> <p>• Align plans with the Brand Media and Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC) teams to maximise the efficiency and impact of total marketing investment, working with them to adjust plans where necessary due to commercial or operational blocks.</p> <p>• Champion data- and AI-driven commercial planning to sharpen investment decisions, forecasting and prioritisation.</p> <p><strong>Commercial, Social & Growth</strong></p> <p>• Bring a commercial lens to everything the team does, spotting opportunities and gaps, developing retailer campaigns and propositions that turn existing and incremental marketing budget into substantial uplifts in product orders and strong return on investment, and partnering and leading with your Sales counterparts (including the Senior Sales Director, Pureplay) and retailers on these conversations.</p> <p>• Champion social-first collaborations with our retail partners (influencer, organic social and affiliate), amplified through wider full funnel (on and offsite) retailer-owned media activations to build reach, engagement and conversion.</p> <p>• Own the digital shelf and content excellence agenda (PDPs, brand stores, search and content) and ensure flawless GTM and NPD support, with assets, listings and launch readiness delivered in time and aligned to launch dates.</p> <p>• Lead the vertical’s presence at selected physical retailer events, partnering with Retail Excellence (Field & Branded Display) and agencies to deliver brand experiences that add commercial value.</p> <p><strong>Budget & Performance</strong></p> <p>• Own your vertical’s multi-million-pound marketing budgets, both contracted A&P (Co-op) and any incremental budget secured, ensuring your team plans and deploys them effectively and adjusting at pace to maximise every pound.</p> <p>• Set the standard for measurement and reporting, ensuring your team reports spend and performance accurately and on time each week to the Head of Retail Marketing and the wider UKI Leadership team, where it feeds into regional and global visibility.</p> <p><strong>Leadership & Collaboration</strong></p> <p>• Lead, motivate and support your team (two Trade Marketing Managers and two Retail Marketing Executives across the five pureplay channels, plus a dotted-line Manager), leading from a place of empathy, owning individual development plans, setting clear objectives and building an unstoppable team.</p> <p>• Work closely with the other vertical leads, and partner end-to-end with Sales, Brand/Category Marketing, SSnA, Studio, Brand Media, IMC and Retail Excellence (Field & Branded Display) to deliver joined-up, best-in-class activation.</p> <p>• Act as the bridge between local execution and global strategy, connecting UKI pureplay activity to global brand media workstreams and representing UKI in cross-market and EMEA forums.</p> <p>• Embody the SharkNinja Outrageously Extraordinary mindset and values, living our leadership principles (including ‘winning is a team sport’), comfortable with ambiguity, energised by rewriting the rule book, and bringing retailers, agencies and colleagues on the journey with you.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Need:</strong></p> <p>• Strong commercial acumen and aptitude with the ability to bring a commercial lens to everything the team does, see the opportunities and the gaps, and partner and lead confidently with Sales counterparts and retailers on commercial conversations.</p> <p>• Experience in retail, trade or channel marketing, ideally within pureplay, e-commerce or marketplace environments (consumer electronics, FMCG or durable goods a plus).</p> <p>• Proven brand-side experience, having worked in-house for a brand or manufacturer. Retailer and/or agency background alongside this is welcome and valuable.</p> <p>• A strong working understanding of full-funnel retail media planning and the digital shelf to enable leading a team of specialists, define what good looks like and challenge the plans guiding where adaptions are needed.</p> <p>• Proven people-leadership experience: managing, coaching and developing a team with empathy, including building individual development plans that grow your people.</p> <p>• Strong budget planning skills, with experience owning and reporting on significant (multi-million-pound) marketing budgets;</p> <p>• Excellent stakeholder management, able to manage upwards to local, regional and global leadership and outwards to senior retail and agency partners with equal confidence.</p> <p>• Confident with fast-paced, test-and-learn ways of working (fail fast and small) and the agility and ambiguity that comes with it - we pivot plans hourly or daily across our three brands and 37 categories on the back of commercial, market, consumer and operational data, and act on it. This is the SharkNinja Outrageously Extraordinary mindset.</p> <p>• Strong analytical, presentation and communication skills at leadership level, with a high level of ownership, entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to keep a helicopter view in a fast-paced, fast-changing environment.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Our Culture</span></strong></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">At SharkNinja, we don’t just raise the bar—we push past it every single day.  </span><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Our Outrageously Extraordinary mindset</span></strong><span data-contrast="auto"> drives us to tackle the impossible, push boundaries, and deliver results that others only dream of. If you thrive on breaking out of your swim lane, you’ll be right at home.</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What We Offer</span></strong></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We offer competitive health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, employee stock purchase options, wellness programs, SharkNinja product discounts, and more. </span><strong><span data-contrast="auto">We empower your personal and professional growth </span></strong><span data-contrast="auto">with high impact Learning Programs featuring bold voices redefining what’s possible. </span><strong><span data-contrast="auto">When you join, you’re not just part of a company—you’re part of an outrageously extraordinary community. </span></strong><span data-contrast="auto">To</span><span data-contrast="auto">gether, we won’t just launch products—</span><strong><span data-contrast="auto">we’ll disrupt entire markets.</span></strong><span data-contrast="auto"> </span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":0,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">At SharkNinja, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are vital to our global success. Valuing each unique voice and blending all of our diverse skills strengthens SharkNinja’s innovation every day. We support ALL associates in bringing their authentic selves to work, making an impact, and having the opportunity for career acceleration. With help from our leadership, associates, and our community, we aim to have equity be a key component of the SharkNinja DNA.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":0,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Learn more about us:</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span> <br><a href="https://sharkninja.com/dei"> </a><a href="https://www.instagram.com

title: Portfolio Risk and Treasury Manager
description: 📈 Who We Are: We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair. We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is traceable and transparent . We're a 160+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a $75M Series B round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over 4,000 UK businesses across 8,500+ sites , with over £75m in value returned to businesses and generators so far. We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy. The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards , came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100 . Learn more about us on our website . 🎙️ The Role We're hiring a Portfolio Risk and Treasury Manager. This role reports directly to the CFO and sits in our Finance team. You will be tem's first dedicated hire in risk oversight and treasury, independent of the teams whose positions and processes you oversee and challenge. It's a solo, individual-contributor role for now: no team to manage, but real ownership of a complex, cross-functional, load-bearing area that touches our pricing and trading engine, FP&A, cash management and our commercial and people teams, and that increasingly matters to how investors, the board and funding partners see tem's risk maturity. tem doesn't yet have anyone who owns liquidity as a discipline, or a second line of defence on risk. Growth in our business is capital-intensive: every collateral demand, margin call, commission payment and new market adds to the cash we need to carry, and the cost of that cash is rarely visible in the decisions that create it. You will build that capability from scratch, bringing treasury and independent risk oversight together, so that tem's risk and liquidity management stands on its own rather than marking its own homework. In your first 12 months, you might: Stand up tem's second line risk function: independent oversight and challenge of our first line risk processes, with risk appetite and limits that are set, monitored and acted on. Build the liquidity models tem runs on, short and long term: working capital, collateral, margin calls, cash runway, and the credit facilities and letters of credit behind them. Put cost of capital into our commercial pricing decisions, so the liquidity a deal consumes is visible at the moment the deal is made. Work with the CFO to secure liquidity provision that scales ahead of the business and new markets. Replace manual portfolio reconciliation with automation, and build our operational risk framework from the ground up. 🚀 Responsibilities Second line oversight: establish and run independent oversight and challenge of tem's first line risk processes across trading and portfolio activity, input into risk appetite and the setting of notional and VaR limits, and monitor ongoing adherence. Liquidity modelling: build and maintain short-term (cash runway, margin call forecasting) and long-term (growth and new market funding) liquidity models, covering generator collateral, hedging counterparty collateral, variation margin, credit facilities and letters of credit. Working capital: own working capital efficiency as a measured, targeted discipline rather than a byproduct of other teams' decisions, working closely with Finance's cash management team. Cost of capital and pricing: develop tem's cost of capital framework, make it usable in pricing, give our pricing and commercial teams the cost of capital impact of their decisions, and challenge decisions that consume liquidity without adequate return. Liquidity risk: model liquidity risk from volume and price variance on energy volumes, run stress scenarios and report liquidity headroom against them. Liquidity supply and funding: work with the CFO to engage lenders, credit facility providers and collateral and letter of credit providers, keep liquidity provision ahead of the business with early visibility of when new capacity is needed, and prepare liquidity and risk materials for funding partners, investors and the board. Operational risk: build tem's operational risk framework from the ground up, including incident reporting and management, and drive automation of portfolio data reconciliation, from hedge contracts and confirmations through to hedge settlement and cash reconciliation with Finance. Reporting and stakeholders: build automated, async-first risk reporting (dashboards and written updates by default, a live sync only when something needs real-time discussion), represent tem with hedging and generator counterparties and funding partners, and communicate risk and liquidity positions clearly to leadership. 🎯 Requirements Must-Haves Risk management or treasury experience from a fintech, quant trading or other digital-native environment: modern, tech-first risk practices rather than legacy, spreadsheet-driven ones. Knowledge of energy markets, energy trading or energy risk management and portfolio balancing. Liquidity modelling experience: working capital, collateral and margin dynamics, and cash forecasting over short and long horizons. Risk modelling experience, including VaR and stress testing, and an understanding of cost of capital and how to translate it into commercial decisions. Data literate: comfortable working with and drawing conclusions from portfolio and risk data. Genuinely curious and intellectually sharp (this is a thinking role, not a process-running one), and confident communicating with senior stakeholders, external counterparties and funding partners. Desirable Experience raising or managing credit facilities, letters of credit or other trade finance. Experience of US electricity markets. Operational risk experience, or familiarity with the Ofgem regulatory environment. Comfortable using AI tools as part of day-to-day work. No coding or SQL required. ✨ Benefits & Perks Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission. 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off. Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons. Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,400 per year for your remote setup. Up to GBP150 or EUR170 per month for wellbeing. 🗣️ Interview Process First call with our Talent Team. Behaviour Interview with the Hiring Manager. Technical Interview with the Team (90 mins). You'll meet with potential peers in this session and will discuss how you would model and stress tem's liquidity, where you would set and monitor risk limits, and how you would make cost of capital usable in pricing decisions, including a practical exercise. title: Founding Business Development Representative
description: TL;DR We're hiring a Founding BDR to build Lovable's business development motion from the ground up. The job is to find, qualify and open the right accounts using a mix of your own outreach and the automation and AI agents you build to run alongside it. You'll own a pipeline number, work closely with our Account Executives globally and build a lot of your own tooling on Lovable itself. This is also how we develop AEs: perform here and you'll be running your own deals within 12 to 18 months. There's no playbook yet, so you'll be helping to write it. Why Lovable? Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we're just getting started. We're building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. Lovable is one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognised on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software. What we're looking for Evidence you can generate pipeline. That could be as a BDR or SDR, a founder, in sales or revenue ops, or by building something that found its own customers. We care about the outcome more than the job title, and we'll ask to see it. You already use AI and automation tooling (LLMs, Clay, n8n or similar) to research, personalise and sequence outreach, and you have opinions about what works and what doesn't. You'd rather automate a repetitive workflow than keep doing it by hand, and you can show us something you've built. Comfortable running outbound into named accounts and getting past the first contact to the people who actually make the decision. Disciplined about qualifying out. A fast, well-reasoned no is a win for the business, and you don't chase volume for its own sake. Able to explain a technical product in business terms to both technical and commercial buyers. You set your own priorities, manage your own pipeline and hold yourself to account. You want to become an Account Executive and are prepared to earn it. Fluent English. A second European language (German, French, Spanish, Italian) is useful. Experience with Lovable, developer tools or a product-led growth motion is a strong plus. What you'll do Design and run outbound systems: signal-based targeting, AI-assisted research, personalised sequences and automated workflows. Measure what converts and improve it every week. Build internal GTM tooling on Lovable, such as enrichment flows, qualification agents and meeting-prep automations. The tooling you build is what the team after you will run on. Qualify inbound demand quickly and thoroughly, and convert the right leads into well-prepared first meetings for the AE team. Multi-thread into target accounts to reach economic buyers and technical decision-makers, not just the first person who replied. Own a pipeline number and report clearly on how much comes from your own outreach versus automation, so we can scale both. Work with the Account Executives you support on account plans, meeting prep and keeping deals moving between touchpoints. Qualify out early and clearly when an account isn't a fit, so the team's time goes where it will pay off. Feed what you're hearing from the market back to Sales, Marketing and Product to sharpen messaging and positioning. Where this role goes This is a development role with a defined path to Account Executive. We expect the people who join as BDRs now to form our next AE team. Structured coaching from day one: weekly call reviews with experienced AEs and your manager, and a curriculum that covers discovery, demo, commercial negotiation and deal management. The expectation that you progress to running your own deals within 12 to 18 months, based on performance rather than tenure. As the first BDR at Lovable, real influence over how the role, the playbook and the tooling are defined for everyone who follows. How we work Based out of our London office Monday to Thursday, with the option to work from home on Fridays. You'll work alongside a highly experienced team of Account Executives and your manager who will coach and support you day to day. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.</p></div><h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>The Role</strong></span></h4> <p>We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer to join our AI Platform team. underline;"><strong>Who You Are</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li>Extensive professional experience in backend software engineering, with expertise in programming languages/technologies like Python, description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color: #662d91;">Teamwork makes the stream work.</h2> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p> </p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About the role</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Join Roku as an Engineering Intern, where your passion for technology and creativity will drive our success. We offer a paid 12-week internship, running from June to early September 2027.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">As an Engineering Intern, you’ll be assigned a scoped project with one of our engineering teams, working on real Roku products and platforms. We’ll match you to the team that best fits your skills and interests, so you may work on anything from user interfaces and embedded or platform software to automation, developer tooling and AI-powered workflows. </span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our teams work across a variety of languages and technologies and embrace GenAI-assisted development to boost productivity and quality.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p> </p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What you’ll be doing</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <ul> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Own a well-defined project that contributes to the success of your team.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code using modern languages, tools and engineering practices.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Debug, test and profile your work, and document it so others can build on it.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Collaborate with engineers and mentors, take part in code reviews, and share your progress and learnings.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> </ul> <p><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Apply if</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <ul> <li><span data-contrast="auto">You are a penultimate-year student, or a final-year student planning to go on to a one-year master’s course.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">You hold a permanent right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider candidates on a student visa.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">You are available for full-time work for the whole 12-week program, from June to early September in Manchester.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">You are keen to work with AI technologies and have previous experience building AI agents and automated workflows.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> </ul> <p><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">We’re excited if you have</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <ul> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Currently enrolled in a degree program in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Proficiency in one or more of C, C++, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript or similar languages, ideally with projects, open source or hackathon work beyond your coursework.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">A solid grounding in computer science fundamentals such as data structures, algorithms, and operating systems or networking concepts.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Hands-on experience using GenAI tools in your coursework, projects or personal work.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Strong problem-solving and technical communication abilities.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Proactive mindset with passion for continuous learning and fast iteration.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> </ul> <p><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">How will I use AI at Roku?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong><span style="font-family: GothamBold, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What are some of the benefits?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Accommodations</strong></h3> <p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to <a ---------- <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What should I know about Roku's culture?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. </p> <p>We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. </p> <p>To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet">https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet</a>.</p> <p>By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/roku-job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-job-applicants">Applicant Privacy Notice</a>, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing <a ----- ----- Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: M&A Intern
description: The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. We're looking for an M&A Intern to join manda, iwoca's M&A platform. This is a paid off-cycle internship of up to 6 months, for someone who wants to build a long-term career in fintech - Hybrid in London. manda is where AI meets Mergers & Acquisitions. Over the last months we've built a proposition for buying and selling UK small businesses. Our first deals are done, and our pipeline is growing across both sell-side and buy-side. Most M&A firms shy away from the sub-£10m EV segment because information asymmetry, lack of knowledge, and low transaction sizes make it hard to serve profitably. iwoca has 150,000+ SME customers in the UK and a track record of building clean, automated processes, and manda is leveraging that to build an M&A platform that serves this market properly. Your edge as an intern: you'll work on live sub-£10m transactions from week one, not pitch books for deals you'll never touch. You'll see the full deal lifecycle (origination, diligence, execution, close) inside a venture small enough that the work you do moves the business, and you'll have AI and automation as leverage rather than as a side project. The team You'll sit inside the manda Deal Team and work directly with the people running the platform: our sell-side and buy-side Transaction Managers, our Due Diligence Manager, and the Venture Lead. The team is small enough that you'll be in the room for real decisions on live deals, and the tooling we use (CRM, VDR, AI automated workflows) is being built in parallel by the same people you'll be working alongside. The role The internship is split into two phases to give you both breadth across the deal engine and depth on a project you own. Phase 1: Core M&A Operations (first 2 months). You'll get to try out several of our live workstreams, and we'll decide your final placement based on deal flow, team priorities and where you add the most. You'll do real day-to-day work supporting the team where it matters most. Workstreams include: Sell-side execution: supporting our sell-side Transaction Managers across the deal lifecycle. Qualifying inbound and outbound vendor leads, preparing materials, populating Virtual Data Rooms, and coordinating buyer Q&A. Buy-side execution: supporting our buy-side Transaction Manager managing the live pipeline of searchers and acquirers. Qualifying buyer mandates, matching them to live sell-side opportunities, and helping move deals through to LOI. Due diligence support: working with our DD Manager on company valuation and diligence for live sell-side mandates. Turning raw SME data into clear reports on business model, financial position, and fair valuation. Origination: identifying SMEs likely to sell, running our "likely seller" models against iwoca's customer base, and converting matches into mandates. Product, data & AI: turning manual workflows into automated ones, mapping the data schema for our "Digital IM", and building AI-enabled tooling that gives our Transaction Managers leverage. You'll work closely with the Venture Lead on this. Phase 2: The project (months 3-6). Once you've built the foundation, you'll scope a project with the Venture Lead to solve a real problem or seize an opportunity you've identified during Phase 1. You'll spend the rest of the internship executing it end-to-end with full ownership and regular check-ins. Examples of the kind of project we'd back: a model that scores acquisition targets against a buyer's mandate, an AI workflow that drafts a first-pass IM from raw accounts, or a structured outbound channel into a new vendor segment. Who you are You're interested in M&A, FinTech, or building things from scratch, and you want to do all three at once. Most importantly, you're smart, motivated, humble, and have a growth mindset. You are need-driven. You take whatever is in front of you and move it forward, whether that's fixing a broken spreadsheet, calling a vendor, or cleaning up CRM data. You don't wait to be told what's important. You are financially literate. You can read a P&L and a balance sheet, spot what's odd, and ask the question that surfaces the real story behind the numbers. You are tech-curious. You bring your own stack, you're already using AI tools to multiply your output, and you treat any manual workflow you see as a candidate for automation. You are a clear communicator. M&A runs on trust. You write professional emails, you're not afraid to pick up the phone, and you can hold a conversation with a business owner about the company they spent 30 years building. Bonus: experience working with SME data, financing, or M&A workflows. The salary & conversion This is a paid internship with annual compensation of £30k. If it goes well and there's a fit on both sides, we'd convert you into a permanent role on the manda team, with compensation re-benchmarked against the new position. The culture At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time. Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions. The benefits Flexible working hours. A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years. Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers. Access to learning platforms like Treehouse. Lead onboarding, ongoing training, and certify the team on every new brand.</li> </ul> <p><strong><br>Key Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven leadership in running a high-volume, high-quality creative or content studio.</li> <li>Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with a knack for building trust with senior brand marketers and navigating complex matrix structures.</li> <li>Strong operational acumen, including capacity planning, resource management, and workflow optimization across global delivery centres.</li> <li>A sharp eye for creative quality and platform-native content, with experience using data and performance metrics to measure and elevate output.</li> <li>Excellent problem-solving abilities, capable of turning scorecard data into actionable quarterly improvements.</li> <li>A passion for people development, with a track record of building, retaining, and growing high-performing teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About You</strong><br>You are a natural leader who thrives at the intersection of operational excellence and creative brilliance. You don't just manage processes; you inspire teams and build unshakeable trust with clients. You are commercially savvy, culturally fluent, and possess a proactive mindset that spots opportunities for improvement before they become issues. If you are ready to drive an engine that produces world-class content for one of the world's most iconic brand portfolios, and you love seeing your team grow alongside the work, you'll be right at home here.</p> <p><strong>Benefits & Culture</strong><br>At Ogilvy, we are a friendly, collaborative, and eclectic team united by a shared commitment to doing the best work of our lives. Beyond client work, you’ll have the chance to shape our vibrant culture, join active social teams, and contribute to our industry-leading DEI initiatives.</p> <p>Here is a snapshot of the benefits we offer:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Hybrid Working:</strong> We embrace a hybrid model that blends collaborative in-office time with the flexibility to work remotely.</li> <li><strong>Annual Leave:</strong> 25 days holiday, a paid volunteering day, plus the option to buy up to 5 additional days.</li> <li><strong>Pension:</strong> a generous matched scheme. Contribute 4% (Ogilvy pays 6%) up to a maximum contribution of 7% (Ogilvy pays 10.5%—totalling a powerful 17.5%).</li> <li><strong>Healthcare & Wellbeing:</strong> BUPA Private Medical Insurance, plus discounted BUPA dental cover or financial contribution towards your physical and mental wellness.</li> <li><strong>Employee Assistance:</strong> 24/7 access to remote GPs, mental health support, physio, nutrition consultations, and confidential counselling for you and your family.</li> <li><strong>Free 1-to-1 Coaching:</strong> Professional and personal growth coaching sessions annually.</li> <li><strong>Life Assurance & Income Protection:</strong> Financial peace of mind for you and your loved ones.</li> </ul> <p>Ogilvy champions innovation and the thoughtful application of AI. We encourage you to use AI tools to enhance your application and achieve the best possible results. During interviews, we may explore how you leverage AI, showcasing your judgment and ability to integrate these technologies effectively.</p> <p>Please ensure your application authentically reflects your own skills, experience, and unique contributions.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p class="x_MsoNormal">Our ambition is to attract the very best diverse talent to Ogilvy, and to be the employer of choice in the UK. title: Corporate Account Executive
description: <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Overview</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p>As a Corporate Account Executive, you will own new-logo ARR growth across private-sector organisations with 2,000–7,499 employees in the UK, Ireland and South Africa. This is a pure acquisition and self-sourcing role with no inherited customer base or ongoing account-management responsibility. While you will have access to BDR, Solution Engineering, Partner Account Management and Marketing support, you remain personally accountable for building sufficient pipeline, creating your own qualified opportunities and achieving the ARR target. Once fully ramped, the role will carry an annual net-new ARR quota in the region of US $900,000.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What will you be doing?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p>You will build, own and execute a territory and pipeline-generation plan that creates sustainable pipeline and converts opportunities into net-new ARR. The territory is not verticalized, so you will use available account intelligence, SKU performance, industry growth and market data to determine where to focus. You will personally self-source qualified opportunities while using internal and partner resources to extend your reach and accelerate results. You will manage the full sales cycle, from account prioritisation and prospecting through discovery, solution alignment, commercial negotiation and close.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Your responsibilities will include:</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Building, owning and executing a data-led territory and pipeline-generation plan that explains how you will achieve your net-new ARR quota, where you will focus, how you will personally create qualified opportunities and which resources you will engage.</li> <li>Generating business exclusively through new-logo acquisition across the defined private-sector segment; the role will not inherit existing customers.</li> <li>Using account, industry, SKU-growth and market data to prioritise opportunities and continually refine your territory strategy.</li> <li>Personally self-sourcing qualified opportunities through disciplined prospecting and account development, while effectively using BDR, Marketing and partner resources to complement—not replace—your own pipeline creation. Building pipeline through a balanced combination of self-sourced activity, BDR support, marketing programmes and partner-led engagement.</li> <li>Working closely with the Partner Account Manager to identify the right partners, develop joint account plans, create pipeline and progress opportunities. As a channel-first organisation, effective partner engagement is fundamental to success in this role.</li> <li>Leading consultative, value-based sales cycles across business, technical and executive stakeholders, positioning a platform outcome rather than relying on a single-product sale.</li> <li>Partnering with Solution Engineering to shape discovery, demonstrate relevant capabilities and build credible business and technical solutions.</li> <li>Planning and delivering compelling presentations, proposals and business cases that connect customer challenges to measurable outcomes, value and return on investment.</li> <li>Maintaining strong deal control throughout complex sales cycles, including stakeholder mapping, qualification, mutual action planning, commercial negotiation and accurate forecasting.</li> <li>Maintaining complete, accurate and current account, opportunity, pipeline and forecast information in the CRM system.</li> <li>Attending customer and partner meetings remotely and in person across the territory; this is a field-based role in which face-to-face collaboration is expected.</li> <li>Coordinating with Customer Success when a new customer reaches the applicable ARR threshold, ensuring an effective transition and appropriate post-sale engagement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Team Behind Your Territory</strong></p> <p>You will retain clear ownership of the territory plan, pipeline creation and ARR result while working as part of a collaborative go-to-market team. The supporting teams provide expertise, reach and leverage, but do not replace the Account Executive’s responsibility to self-source opportunities and create sufficient pipeline. Support available includes:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Business Development Representative:</strong> support with targeted prospecting, account engagement and meeting creation.</li> <li><strong>Solution Engineer:</strong> technical discovery, demonstrations, solution design and technical validation.</li> <li><strong>Partner Account Manager:</strong> partner strategy, account alignment, introductions, joint pipeline creation and channel-led deal execution.</li> <li><strong>Marketing:</strong> campaigns, events, content, intent signals and account-based support.</li> <li><strong>Customer Success:</strong> post-sale engagement for customers that meet the applicable ARR threshold.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Is this the role for you?</strong><br><br>We are looking for an entrepreneurial, commercially focused sales professional who is comfortable creating a market rather than inheriting one. You will be confident making evidence-based choices about where to invest your time, mobilising internal and partner resources, and remaining accountable for the execution of your plan and the ARR outcome.</p> <p><strong>To be successful in this role, you will bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A strong track record of winning net-new business and meeting or exceeding ARR or ACV-based quotas in a complex B2B sales environment.</li> <li>Experience managing full-cycle software or technology sales into medium-to-large private-sector organisations.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to build productive channel relationships and create and close partner-led opportunities in a channel-first model.</li> <li>Experience developing and executing territory and account plans using market, industry, product and account data, with a proven ability to self-source qualified pipeline.</li> <li>Confidence selling to business, technical and executive stakeholders and translating complex requirements into clear commercial value.</li> <li>Strong pipeline creation, qualification, forecasting, negotiation and closing discipline.</li> <li>Excellent communication, presentation, listening and stakeholder-management skills.</li> <li>The initiative, resilience and accountability to operate independently while bringing the right cross-functional resources together.</li> </ul> <p><span data-contrast="auto">A collaborative, curious and adaptable approach, with the willingness to test new ideas and continuously improve.</span></p> <p><strong>Benefits we offer:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Market-competitive compensation including uncapped commission structure with accelerators </li> <li>30 days of annual leave, in addition to public holidays</li> <li>Company pension scheme</li> title: Senior Revenue Accounting Manager (12m FTC)
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. We're looking for a Senior Revenue Accounting Manager to join our London team. This is a hybrid role and 12month FTC contract. In this role, you'll help us strengthen our revenue accounting operations and controls while driving alignment with global financial processes. Get to know our Finance team: what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect. What You'll Be Doing Oversee month-end close operations for revenue accounting, reviewing high-risk journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and strategic flux analyses to ensure U.S. GAAP compliance. Lead the identification and resolution of complex data issues and systemic reconciliation gaps, establishing automated workflows to prevent future discrepancies. Own end-to-end revenue accounting strategies, providing high-level technical guidance to finance leadership and delegating specialized analyses to junior staff. Drive the annual external audit strategy for revenue, serving as the primary lead for key technical accounting schedules and management responses. Build and lead cross-functional partnerships across Finance, Legal, Sales, and Product to streamline contract reviews, establish robust policies, and enforce compliance. Design, implement, and maintain the SOX control framework across all revenue operations, ensuring continuous monitoring and zero control deficiencies. Advanced data analytics capability using SQL and visualization tools to evaluate complex revenue models, forecast trends, and drive strategic business insights. Initiate and execute high-priority ad-hoc strategic projects, technology implementations, and process transformations across the finance function. Leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) to accelerate data analysis, automate routine reconciliation tasks, and draft documentation – demonstrating fluency in AI-assisted workflows as part of the role's operating standard What You'll Need to Thrive Essential: Experience with MS Excel and Google Sheets Experience with NetSuite (or an equivalent ERP), Professional accountancy qualification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, or equivalent). Public company accounting experience within a relevant industry, alongside proven experience leading and developing others. Strong technical knowledge of revenue recognition (ASC 606 / IFRS 15), U.S. GAAP, IFRS, and SOX internal controls. Proven track record of managing full-cycle financial close processes and maintaining robust accounting operations. Proven ability to build alignment across teams and manage relationships with senior stakeholders. Ability to connect day-to-day revenue detail with longer-term commercial goals. Comfort brings clarity to ambiguity and working independently in a rapidly changing environment. Nice to Have: Experience with Snowflake and using SQL for data querying and financial modelling Active, proven usage of AI tools (LLMs and coding assistants) in day-to-day work; be prepared to discuss specific examples Why Join Us? At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. title: Senior Director of Product Management, Models and Data
description: About Niantic Spatial AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It can't yet reason about real places well enough for robots, field crews and AI agents to rely on it, and closing that gap will change how factories, power grids, cities and defense operations run. That's one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it's the one we're solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are. In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That's why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right. Our team built some of the world's most widely used maps. Now we're building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us. About the Role The Large Geospatial Model is Niantic Spatial's foundation model of the physical world. It learns from years of real-world captures of millions of places, and people, robots and AI agents use it to find out where they are, what is around them and what has changed. Each step up in scale has given the model capabilities it did not have before. The next problems are some of the hardest in AI: filling in the parts of a place no camera saw while marking what was inferred, measuring what changed between visits, and predicting what will change next. Customers already use the model in production. Energy companies use it to guide field crews to equipment on large industrial sites, defense partners use it for positioning where GPS is jammed or unavailable, and robotics companies train robots in metric-scale copies of the real sites they will work in. You will be the first product leader for the model and the data it learns from, reporting to the Chief Product Officer. You decide which capabilities it gains and in what order, the bar each release has to clear, and what data Niantic Spatial collects, licenses or partners for to get there. You set those priorities directly with the Chief Scientist and the London research team who train the model. If you have shipped a frontier language model, most of the job will be familiar: evals, data mix and release decisions. The job differs in two ways. Every output of this model can be scored against a measured real place, so its evals rest on ground truth. And its data is collected in the physical world, so choosing what to capture next is a product decision with a real cost. Experience in 3D or mapping is welcome but not required. By the end of your first year, research, engineering and the product leads for industrial, defense, robotics and platform customers work from one model roadmap that you own, each release ships against evals you wrote, and the model's newest capabilities are in customers' hands. What You'll Do Own the Model Roadmap - Decide the order in which the Large Geospatial Model gains its next capabilities, from filling in unseen parts of a site to measuring and predicting change, based on what industrial, defense, robotics and platform customers will pay for. Turn customer problems into specific research requirements, and bring new research results to the product leads who sell into each market. Set the Release Bar - Define the evals and acceptance criteria for each capability with the Real-World Test Lab, which measures model output against ground truth in real places. Decide whether each release ships or goes back for more data or training. Own the Data Plan - Decide what data Niantic Spatial collects, buys, licenses or gets through partners, and set the product terms of those deals with Legal and Business Development. Set the curation, labeling, consent, privacy and training-rights requirements every dataset has to meet, and keep a record of which data went into each model version. Turn Capabilities into Products - Decide when a new model capability is ready to become something customers buy, what it promises them, and how it reaches them through Niantic Spatial's products and platform. Set the Long-Term Direction - Decide where the model goes over the next several years, as it moves from describing places as they are to tracking how they change and anticipating what comes next, and make the case for the research and data investment that takes. What You'll Bring 8+ years in product management, including at least three years shipping a large model to users or customers. Experience writing evals for a model and using them to decide when a release was ready. Direct work on training data, such as setting a data mix, running labeling or human-feedback programs, or negotiating data licenses. Enough depth in how large models are trained, post-trained and evaluated that researchers bring you into their technical decisions.
