title: Tools Developer (Rust / Linux)
description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. About the Software organisation at Fractile Developer Experience sits within the Software organisation at Fractile, which is responsible for developing a full software stack for our groundbreaking AI inference systems. That's everything from ML compilers, device drivers and systems firmware, application level runtime and ecosystem integrations, ML and compute libraries, great developer tooling and a full portfolio of simulators, through to datacenter scale workload deployment solutions. At Fractile, we know that a fantastic software stack is a critical and central part of any AI inference solution and it sits at the heart of everything we're doing. About the team and role The tools built by the Developer Experience team are how engineers — both inside Fractile and at our customers — see, control and understand the Fractile inference accelerator. That means the command-line utilities used to discover, configure and health-check devices; the diagnostics used during hardware bring-up and in the datacentre; and the profiling, tracing and debugging tools that show where the time goes across the host, the driver and the silicon. As a Tools Developer you will design and build these tools in Rust, running on Linux hosts from a single developer workstation against large datacentre deployments. You will work closely with the hardware, firmware, kernel driver, runtime and Developer Experience teams to understand what they need, and turn that into fast, reliable and well-designed tools that fit naturally into existing Linux workflows. This is largely greenfield work, with real scope to shape how our tooling is architected and how it is used. About you You enjoy building tools that other engineers rely on every day, and you care about getting the details right: clear output, sensible defaults, good error messages and behaviour you can script against. You are at home on Linux, comfortable working anywhere from the shell down to sysfs, ioctls and the kernel/userspace boundary, and you know how to find out what a system is actually doing when it misbehaves. You are self-driven, able to identify tooling opportunities for yourself, and happy to work autonomously in areas of ambiguity. Key Requirements Strong Rust skills, with experience shipping production-quality tools or libraries Knowledge of Linux from a developer's perspective: processes, memory, filesystems, sysfs/procfs, device files and ioctls, systemd and the kernel/userspace interface Experience designing command-line tools and APIs that are easy to learn, script and automate Experience working with stakeholders across multiple teams Nice to Have Experience writing tools for PCIe-attached devices, GPUs or other ML accelerators Experience using CUDA, ROCm, Vulkan Compute, or similar Familiarity with tracing and telemetry formats or systems such as Perfetto, Chrome trace format, OpenTelemetry or Prometheus Experience exposing Rust libraries to Python (e.g. PyO3) or C Experience with Bazel, CI/CD or packaging software for Linux distributions What We Offer Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role. Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance. Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment. Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us! description: CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth trusted by more than 1,300 global brands and agencies. It’s been named a Fastest-Growing Company in North America on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ for four years, was named a leader in IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Influencer Marketing Platforms for Large Enterprises in 2025, was named a Leader by The Forrester New Wave™: Influencer Marketing Solutions, and has been consistently recognized by G2 as a Leader, and is rated 5 stars on Influencer MarketingHub. We're seeking passionate, innovative minds to join our journey. Be a part of our dynamic team and let's transform the industry together! Product Manager, Messaging We’re looking for a Product Manager who wants to own how brands actually talk to creators at scale. This role owns CreatorIQ’s messaging product: the unified inbox and composer that creator marketing teams live in every day, the sending infrastructure underneath it, and the automation and agentic layer we’re building on top. Messaging is where creator relationships are won or lost, and the opportunity is to let AI do the work a manager currently does one message at a time, on infrastructure that can actually carry it. If you love turning a messy, high-volume communication problem into workflows that marketers trust — and you have the taste to tell when AI-drafted outreach genuinely sounds like the brand versus when it’s impressive-looking slop a creator will ignore — you’ll fit right in. We’re growing fast, building in an evolving AI and agentic landscape, and working with teams around the world who care about doing great work without the ego. In this role, you'll get to: Take real ownership of the creator messaging experience end to end — inbox, composer, threads, templates — iterating from messy problem to shipped feature. You’ll measure, learn, and do it again. Own the agentic layer of messaging: outreach that drafts itself, sequences that adapt, and automations a marketer can trust to run without watching. You’ll decide what the agent does on its own, what it proposes, and where a human has to sign off. Shape how brand voice and comms style become real product primitives, so automated messaging sounds like the customer instead of like a template — and have the backbone to cut scope when the output isn’t there yet. Partner with engineering on the sending infrastructure all of this rests on: flexible mailbox connectivity (Gmail, Outlook, SMTP, IMAP/POP), isolated per-customer sending environments, dedicated domains and reputation, tracking, and volume throttling. Make deliverability a product feature rather than a support ticket — authentication setup a non-technical user can actually complete, domain warm-up, bounce and unsubscribe handling, and clear in-product answers when a message doesn’t send. Run discovery with real users — creator marketing managers, agency teams, program ops — and turn their workflows, volumes, and frustrations into clear requirements. Look beyond the backlog. Spot opportunities across the messaging and marketing agent roadmap, challenge assumptions, and help shape where the product goes next — including channels past email, like SMS, WhatsApp, and platform DMs. Who you are and what you'll need for this position: You’ve spent 4+ years in product management (or equivalent technical product ownership) in B2B SaaS — titles matter less than the work. You have a builder’s mindset. You prototype. You’d rather put a rough working thing in front of someone this week than write a document about it for three, and you use AI tools to build that thing yourself. You have genuinely good product taste, specifically for AI output: you can look at generated copy, a prototype, or an agent’s behavior and tell whether it’s good, and you can articulate why. You either understand email deliverability — SPF/DKIM/DMARC, domain and IP reputation, warm-up, bounce and complaint handling — or you’ll go deep on it fast. You’re comfortable with how modern AI features work in practice: prompting, context, evaluation, confidence, human-in-the-loop review, and where an agent should and shouldn’t be allowed to act alone. You’re technical enough to hold your own on infrastructure conversations — APIs, data models, queues, third-party integrations — and to recognize when a “small” request is actually touching something big. You can map workflows fast, write clear requirements, and explain your thinking without needing a meeting to do it. You’re curious, self-driven, low-ego, and allergic to “that’s not my job.” Comfortable working with distributed teams. Most work is async and flexible, but occasionally we’ll ask for a later call. Nice to have: Experience shipping email or messaging software — marketing automation, sales engagement, CRM, or an ESP. Familiarity with AWS SES or comparable sending infrastructure, and with mailbox integrations (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, SMTP/IMAP). Experience with responsive email HTML, template systems, or WYSIWYG editors. Experience with SMS/MMS, WhatsApp Business, or social DM integrations, including the consent and compliance requirements that come with them. Familiarity with customer-facing APIs, webhooks, or enterprise integrations. Experience with influencer marketing, creator workflows, or martech. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About THG</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":160,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our portfolio of</span><span data-contrast="auto"> leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG. </span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p></div><h4>Role: Senior Ecommerce Manager</h4> <p><strong>Brand: Myprotein</strong></p> <p><strong>Reporting to: Ecommerce Director </strong></p> <p><strong>Location: THG ICON 1, 7-9 Sunbank Lane, WA15 0AF (Fully Office Based) </strong></p> <h4 data-pm-slice="1 1 []"></h4> <p data-pm-slice="1 3 []">As Senior Ecommerce Manager for the UK, you will own the commercial performance of Myprotein's UK website, driving profitable growth through effective ecommerce trading, customer experience and onsite optimisation.</p> <p>You will set the UK ecommerce strategy, translating commercial objectives and customer insight into clear trading priorities. Combining strong commercial judgement with data-led decision-making, you will identify opportunities, drive performance and lead cross-functional teams to deliver growth.</p> <h2>The Details</h2> <ul> <li>Own UK website performance across revenue, traffic, conversion, AOV, margin and profitability.</li> <li>Set and deliver the UK ecommerce trading strategy, translating business targets into clear priorities and action plans.</li> <li>Drive onsite trading and optimisation across merchandising, navigation, search, landing pages and promotional activity.</li> <li>Manage pricing and promotional investment, balancing revenue growth, margin and customer experience.</li> <li>Lead forecasting and performance reviews, identifying risks, opportunities and actions to maximise trading performance.</li> <li>Use customer insight, competitor activity and market trends to inform commercial decisions and identify growth opportunities.</li> <li>Partner with Marketing, CRM, Brand, Product, UX, Technology, Supply Chain and Finance to deliver the UK growth agenda.</li> <li>Drive improvements across the customer journey, increasing conversion, basket size, retention and customer lifetime value.</li> <li>Lead testing and optimisation initiatives, using clear hypotheses and measurable commercial outcomes.</li> <li>Champion AI, automation and analytics to improve decision-making, efficiency and trading effectiveness.</li> <li>Influence senior stakeholders and hold cross-functional teams accountable for delivering commercial priorities.</li> </ul> <h3>What We Are Looking For</h3> <ul> <li>Significant experience in ecommerce, digital trading or online retail, ideally within a fast-paced DTC or consumer business.</li> <li>Proven track record of owning website performance and delivering profitable commercial growth.</li> <li>Strong understanding of ecommerce trading metrics, including revenue, conversion, AOV, margin and customer lifetime value.</li> <li>Experience developing and executing trading strategies and onsite optimisation plans.</li> <li>Strong commercial judgement, with the ability to balance growth, profitability and customer experience.</li> <li>Highly analytical and data-driven, able to turn insight into clear commercial actions.</li> <li>Proactive and autonomous, with a strong bias for action and personal accountability.</li> <li>Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead cross-functional teams.</li> <li>Experience in testing, optimisation and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Confident using BI and ecommerce analytics tools, with an interest in leveraging AI and automation to improve performance.</li> <li>Clear communicator, comfortable challenging thinking and driving decisions at pace.</li> </ul> <h2>What’s in It for Me?</h2> <h3>Career Development</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Access bespoke development programmes designed by our in-house Learning & Development team.</p> </li> <li> <p>Develop your expertise through our upskilling programme, delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Enhanced Leave</h3> <ul> <li> <p>25 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays.</p> </li> <li> <p>Enjoy your birthday off, on us!</p> </li> <li> <p>Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.</p> </li> <li> <p>Up to 10 days’ compassionate leave.</p> </li> <li> <p>Option to buy up to 3 additional days of annual leave each year.</p> </li> <li> <p>Unlock 2 days of volunteer leave after 12 months.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Wellbeing Support</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP.</p> </li> <li> <p>Access our 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme, provided by Bupa.</p> </li> <li> <p>State-of-the-art on-site gym.</p> </li> <li> <p>Access to our on-site physiotherapist.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Other Perks</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Save up to 12% on personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme.</p> </li> <li> <p>Subsidised bus pass from Manchester City Centre to our ICON office.</p> </li> <li> <p>Up to 50% staff discount on THG brands.</p> </li> <li> <p>On-site staff shop and barber.</p> </li> <li> <p>Refer someone to THG and receive up to £1,000 when they pass their probation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Anniversary gifts when you reach 5 and 10 years of service.</p> </li> </ul> <p>We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>THG is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.</strong></p> <p><strong>THG is committed to creating a diverse & inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.</strong></p> <p><strong>Because of the high volumes of applications our opportunities attract, it sometimes takes us time to review and consider them all. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. If you haven't heard from us within that time frame or should you have any specific questions about this or other applications for positions at THG please contact one of our <span class="mark75xs2u5gf" data-markjs="true" data-ogac="" data-ogab="" data-ogsc="" data-ogsb="">Talent</span> team to discuss further.</strong></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Director of Product (Head of International - Real Time Operations)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Join Axon and be a Force for Good.</strong></h4> <p>At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.<br><br>Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><h3><strong>The Role</strong></h3> <p>As Head of International – Real Time Operations, you will own the strategy and execution for expanding the Fusus platform into international markets. deliverables and sustainability.<br><br>This position requires a leader who can both lead directly and influence without direct authority, working across product, engineering, sales, and program teams regional security, privacy, and data residency standards critical to customer trust and adoption.</li> <li>Drive continuous improvement in tender readiness, adoption, and customer success metrics </strong></h3> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This role is based out of our London office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.<br><strong>Reports to: </strong>SVP & General Manager</p> <ul> <li>Build strong partnerships across Axon (devices, digital evidence, productivity solutions) to deliver integrated outcomes internationally.</li> <li>Lead direct engagement with international customers, regulators, and partners to distill insights into product priorities.</li> <li>Establish a clear execution path within 90 days that defines roadmap priorities and sequencing for international expansion.</li> <li>Align with the Head of International (Core Products & New Markets) to ensure RTO’s global efforts are consistent with company-wide strategy.</li> <li>Create frameworks and processes that balance local customization with global scale.</li> <li>Serve as a visible leader and trusted advisor for RTO’s international strategy, both internally and externally.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You Bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years of product management experience in enterprise SaaS, real-time operations, VSaaS, VMS, IoT, or public safety technology.</li> <li>Proven success in international product leadership, including experience scaling platforms across multiple regions with diverse compliance and operational requirements.</li> <li>Experience partnering with sales leadership on tender-driven opportunities, translating deal pipelines into prioritized product roadmaps.</li> <li>Strong understanding of global compliance standards (privacy, data residency, security) and their impact on product delivery.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to harmonize requirements across geographies while balancing global parity vs. regional differentiation.</li> <li>Excellent communication and collaboration skills; able to influence senior leaders and cross-functional teams without direct authority.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Who You Are</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Visionary:</strong> Anticipates international market needs and positions Axon ahead of competitors.</li> <li><strong>Commercially Astute:</strong> Connects product strategy to tender wins, deal pipelines, and business impact.</li> <li><strong>#Join Forces Leader:</strong> Thrives in cross-functional, collaborative environments.</li> <li><strong>Operationally Disciplined:</strong> Brings clarity and structure to complex, multi-region priorities.</li> <li><strong>Customer-Obsessed:</strong> Ensures that every decision ladders up to better outcomes for global customers.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why Now</strong></h3> <p>Global demand for real-time intelligence and operational platforms is growing rapidly. title: Customer Success Manager
description: At Klue , We’re Building the Future of Competitive Intelligence The Customer Success team is hiring 👋 You're the person who walks into an account and immediately sees what matters: the risk no one's named yet, the expansion hiding in plain sight, the champion waiting to be developed. You earn trust fast, ask the right questions, and turn a customer's goals into a plan that actually sticks. If that sounds like you, keep reading. We'd love to meet you. As a Customer Success Manager at Klue, you own the full customer relationship, from onboarding through renewal and expansion. You're the connective tissue: keeping every account team aligned, every customer growing, and every risk on the radar before it becomes a problem. Klue's product moves fast. New AI agents, integrations, and capabilities ship continuously. The CSMs who thrive here stay ahead of it, act on signals early, and show up as both a trusted advisor and a confident commercial partner. Your Mission? To make sure every customer in your book gets real, measurable value from Klue, and grows because of it. You build the relationships, drive the adoption, and close the commercial outcomes. When your customers win, you win. What's In It for You? This role puts you at the center of how B2B companies use competitive intelligence to win deals, grow revenue, and own their markets. You'll work across industries and stakeholder levels, build deep customer intuition, and gain hard-won experience running complex change management inside leading organizations. In an AI-first company shipping continuously, your expertise compounds fast. No two years here look the same. What You'll Do Own Renewals and Expansions. Your book, your number. You forecast it, manage it, and hit it. That means spotting churn signals before anyone else names them, building the business case for expansion, and running cross-sell motions with Sales, including Klue's win-loss interview program. The commercial outcomes are yours. Drive Adoption and Platform Completeness. Klue ships fast. Your job is to make sure every customer keeps up: AI agents running, integrations live, Curators and Consumers actually using the platform. You stay current on what's new and make it land, translating product velocity into conversations your customers care about. Map Outcomes and Demonstrate ROI. You connect Klue to what your customers actually care about: win rate, rep confidence, PMM efficiency. You quantify it, document it, and make it impossible to argue with at renewal time. ROI isn't a slide you build at the end, it's a story you're telling all year. Multi-Thread and Lead Change. Single-threaded accounts are at-risk accounts. You build across levels by default: economic buyers, Champions, Consumers, exec sponsors. You help customers navigate their own organizations and drive adoption through real friction, not around it. Lead the Account Team. You own the account, which means owning the strategy and everyone working inside it. Win-Loss Researchers, PMAs, Sales, AI Solutions. You set the direction. They execute alongside you. What Success Looks Like We want you to love the role you're in and believe these are the things that matter most. You'll know you're nailing it when: GRR and expansion targets are met or exceeded for your book every quarter. All eligible customers have their AI agents running: right competitors tracked, right integrations live, platform usage above benchmarks. Upsell and cross-sell opportunities are identified, qualified, and closed at or above target. Win-loss cross-sell pipeline exists and is actively moving for eligible accounts. Every account has at least one documented ROI moment per quarter, tied to a specific Klue outcome. Every account has at least two active contacts at different levels. No single-threaded accounts in your book. Customers are activated on new product capabilities within one quarter of release. Risk is flagged and acted on early, not discovered at renewal. What You Bring Must Haves: The experience. track record in a CSM or commercial role with direct revenue accountability. You've owned renewals and expansion targets and hit them. Ownership. ability to lead and coordinate a cross-functional account team without direct authority. Customer facing. Proven success building trust and credibility across a customer organization, from day-to-day champions to executive buyers. Commercial fluency. comfortable with upsell conversations, business-case development, and navigating contract dynamics with confidence. Strong discovery skills. can diagnose a customer's business goals, connect them to Klue's platform outcomes, and make the link explicit and repeatable. Change management instinct. knows how to build internal Champions, navigate complex stakeholder dynamics, and drive adoption against organizational friction. Multi-threading instinct. you build relationships across levels by default, not as a recovery strategy. Signal awareness and speed. proactively identifies risk and opportunity in customer behavior, usage data, and relationship health, and acts fast. Technical curiosity. comfortable learning integrations and AI capabilities, and explaining them clearly to non-technical audiences. AI-fluency. actively uses AI tools in day-to-day work and can model that behavior with customers. Nice-to-Haves: Experience in competitive intelligence, product marketing, sales enablement, or B2B SaaS. Familiarity with technical integrations (MCP, CRM, Slack, or similar) and comfort guiding customers through deployment. Knowledge of competitive enablement best practices and how revenue teams operationalize competitive programs. Hands-on experience with AI tools beyond basic usage: prompt design, workflow automation, or AI-assisted customer work. Benefits: Competitive base compensation plus variable Monthly Pension Contribution Extended health & dental benefits that kick in within your first month in seat Opportunity to participate in our Employee Stock Option Plan Time off. Take what you need. We want the team to prioritize wellness and avoid burnout. Vacation usually falls into 3 categories: recharging, life-event, & keeping a work-life balance. Just ensure the required work gets done and clear it with your team in advance. You need to take at least 28 days off every year. Direct access to our leadership team, including our CEO Be part of a high performing team who know how to celebrate their success! ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️ Not ticking every box? That’s okay. We take potential into consideration. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be accepted in lieu of the specifics listed above. If you know you have what it takes, even if that’s different from what we’ve described, be sure to explain why in your application. At Klue, we're committed to building a high-performing team where people feel a strong sense of belonging, can be their authentic selves, and are able to reach their full potential. If there’s anything we can do to make our hiring process more accessible or to better support you, please let us know, we’re happy to accommodate. Why Klue Might Be the Perfect Fit For You At Klue, you’ll push the boundaries of what’s possible. For yourself, your team, and our customers. The environment here feels more startup than corporate. You’ll roll up your sleeves, build, iterate, and level up. This is a place where your ideas matter, you can shape what comes next, and leave your mark. If you’re looking to join a category-defining company… where you own big outcomes, influence real customers, and work with smart, gritty people… you’ll thrive here. Unlock Your Potential. Take Risks. Take Action. Innovate How We Work at Klue We love the balance of connection and flexibility. We work Office-First , with a hybrid touch, and work together in our vibrant offices on Mondays, Wednesdays & Thursdays to collaborate, brainstorm, and build together. Our main hiring hubs are in: 🇨🇦 Vancouver (HQ) 🇨🇦 Toronto 🇬🇧 London Our Commitment to You High Performance Culture. We reward high performance and growth through career development, coaching, and annual performance reviews. Comprehensive benefits: Extended health & dental coverage that starts on Day 1. Fun perks like discounts at Goodlife and Perkopolis are gravy. Ownership: All full-time employees have the opportunity to participate in our Employee Stock Option Plan. Our Vacation Policy is Take The Time You Need. We just ask that you give notice and don’t leave your team hanging. Top-tier tools. All employees will receive a Mac (or PC, if that’s your jam) and access to A+ tooling. AI First. All employees are encouraged to lean into AI to work smarter and faster. Built something cool lately? Show us at our Friday Show, Don’t Tell Meetings. Growth / Leadership. Direct access to our leadership team, including our CEO, and opportunities to connect with incredible people across the company. Social connection. There’s no shortage of ways to stay connected and have fun. We get together once a year in Vancouver for a company- wide kickoff. Throughout the year our Hubs hold regular social events. Dog-friendly spaces. Bring your four-legged friend along in Vancouver or Toronto, as our offices are pup-approved. About Klue We’re on a mission to help organizations stop losing winnable deals. Klue’s AI agents generate market, competitor, and buyer insights in a unified platform. We ensure it’s trustworthy, automated, and activated across every department, so they have the answers they need to own their market. ✨ Here’s what makes us tick: Klue is AI-first at its core. It’s wired deep into our internal processes and tooling, powering our small but mighty team. It drives Klue’s autonomous agents that handle the heavy lifting for customers: collecting intel, generating insights, and ensuring content is updated and available across departments. Our agents help them scale their impact, stay ahead of the market, and reclaim the time that used to be consumed by manual, repetitive busywork. Competitor Insights. Klue helps revenue teams win more competitive deals by turning market, competitor, and buyer signals into insights teams can actually use. Our AI analyzes calls, CRM data, and real buyer feedback to give product marketers and sellers a clear picture of what’s happening in their market and why deals are won or lost. We’re a curious, collaborative team building a platform that helps companies compete with confidence, and we’re looking for people who want to do meaningful work alongside others who care about craft and impact. A culture of curiosity, ownership and winning together . We’re a fast-growing, globally-distributed team based in Vancouver (with hubs like Toronto), scaling quicker than ever. We value people who own their domain, act boldly, stay curious and thrive in a collaborative, high-performance environment. title: Data Architect
description: 🍊Our mission Great science regularly stalls in the clinic, not because the science is wrong, but because the company behind it lacks the capital, infrastructure, or focus to take it all the way through. Today’s clinical-stage biopharma model is broken, and as a result promising treatments never reach patients. Our mission is to fix this: we’re building the next generation of biopharma by in-licensing clinical-stage therapeutic assets and developing them through Lindus Health’s integrated, technology-first clinical trial infrastructure. We’re a new initiative, but we’re building on a proven foundation - the same infrastructure that has delivered 82% of Lindus Health’s sponsor trials on or ahead of timeline, across 40+ completed trials across the US and Europe. We’re in-licensing 5-7 clinical-stage, typically Phase-2-ready assets, funded directly from Lindus Health’s balance sheet. We’re targeting deal close on our first assets through 2026, with first trials launching in H1 2027. 🍊About the role The Data Architect owns assigned studies end-to-end, taking full responsibility for both the design of the database on Citrus and the quality of the data it produces, from study planning through database lock. The role designs with the final analysis in mind, writes code where manual review would slow delivery, and designs the edit checks and validation that prevent issues before they make their way downstream. The Data Architect is the technical and data lead for assigned studies and works with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Programme Directors, and Product to ensure each study captures the data its scientific objectives require. One person owns the database from study planning through lock, so the design and the data it produces never drift apart. The role also shapes how data delivery on Citrus develops, identifying where manual work can be automated. 🍊About you You have around 5+ years of experience across clinical data management and/or trial platform design, with hands-on involvement in study setup, data review, and database lock You can design a study's data capture on an EDC platform and define its specification: you understand edit checks and validation, and you can see how a design decision today could become a data quality problem later You work with data programmatically, or are ready to build that skill quickly: Python, R, or SQL are used daily in this role, and you are expected to learn them on the job if you do not already have them You have working knowledge of CDISC standards, particularly CDASH, with SDTM familiarity a plus, and you design with analysis-ready data in mind You have experience with external data transfers and reconciliation You understand GCP, ICH E6 and 21 CFR Part 11 and apply them in day-to-day decisions You apply AI and automation responsibly to improve the quality and speed of data work in a regulated setting You have a track record of working well across functions, especially Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Programme Directors, and Product You thrive in a startup environment that challenges the norms of typical biotechs, with high agency and a bias for action You are passionate about our mission: changing how the healthcare industry operates and how new health treatments are developed 🍊What you’ll focus on Own your assigned studies end-to-end, from defining critical data items and the data management plan through to database lock Own the design of your studies on Citrus, utilizing AI combined with your expert review to translate protocol requirements into a specification and edit check logic that capture clean, analysis-ready data, and sign off that the design meets the protocol before go-live Assess feasibility and flag complexity and risk early, where a design choice could affect data integrity, participant safety or study endpoints Manage the full query lifecycle from generation through resolution, working directly with sites Lead proactive, risk-based data review, automated where possible, to keep key study milestones on track, building repeatable checks rather than one-off reports Use scripting and AI tooling day-to-day to automate data review, flag anomalies, and surface issues earlier, applied responsibly within validation, GCP and 21 CFR Part 11 expectations Own fixes and change requests on your own studies during conduct, assessing their impact and the level of testing and sign-off required Perform ongoing safety data review and facilitate medical coding (MedDRA, WHODrug) with the medical team Build reports using programmatic data access (Python, R, SQL), delivered accurately and on schedule Conduct all activities in line with relevant regulations and Lindus SOPs, keep study documentation to a standard that holds up under audit or inspection, and support auditors and inspectors on your studies where needed Report bugs and usability issues, and feed operational insight back to Product to improve how description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. Role purpose The Senior Analyst, Underwriting Quality Control (QC) will establish and continually improve a consistent, risk-based quality control framework for work completed by Underwriters. The role will build on existing QC practices and tools, tailoring them to the Underwriting lifecycle, products, risk decisions and operating model. The role provides an objective, evidence-led check that underwriting assessments and outcomes are complete, consistent, appropriately documented and aligned with internal policy, procedures and applicable requirements. It will turn review results into clear management information, actionable feedback, targeted training and measurable improvements in underwriting quality. This is a hands-on role. The Senior Analyst will conduct QC reviews, maintain the framework and reporting, follow findings through to verified remediation, and work with Underwriters and leaders to address recurring gaps. The role reports to the Director of Underwriting and influences quality across the function without replacing the Underwriter’s decision-making accountability. Key responsibilities Build and own the QC framework Assess existing QC materials, controls, data and workflows; identify what should be retained, improved or introduced for Underwriting. Design, document and implement an Underwriting-specific QC framework, including scope, risk-based sampling, review cadence, test scripts, scoring and severity definitions, evidence standards, escalation routes, dispute handling, calibration and remediation expectations. Tailor testing to the relevant underwriting stages, products, merchant and business models, risk tiers and applicable regional requirements. Define practical service levels and ownership for review, feedback, acknowledgement, remediation, re-review and closure, agreeing these with Underwriting leadership. Establish appropriate governance and records so that QC decisions and remediation are traceable and ready for internal or external review. Perform and calibrate QC reviews Review completed underwriting cases and test whether the case record is complete, and appropriately documented. Depending on case scope, this may include business model products, services and geographies; ownership, control and beneficial ownership; company and identity evidence; KYC/KYB and screening outcomes; licences and regulatory status; financial and operational evidence and accurate system records. Identify missing, inconsistent, stale or insufficient evidence, and opportunities to improve decision quality. Drive remediation and constructive challenge Communicate findings promptly, clearly and fairly to the relevant Underwriter and manager, with evidence and an actionable explanation of what needs to change. Track acknowledgement, corrective action and deadlines; proactively chase overdue responses and escalate unresolved or repeat issues. Work with Underwriters and leaders to understand root causes and ensure remediation addresses the underlying issue, not only the individual case. Reporting, insight and continuous improvement Produce regular, accurate QC reporting for Underwriting leadership, with clear commentary on coverage, pass and defect rates, severity, recurring themes, remediation status, turnaround and trends by relevant team, workflow, product or risk segment. Support internal audit, Compliance, Risk and other assurance requests by providing accurate QC records and explaining methodology and outcomes. Build underwriting capability Identify capability gaps from QC findings and partner with Underwriting leaders and relevant subject-matter experts to design and deliver focused training, coaching and practical guidance. What Success Looks Like The ideal candidate is a rigorous and constructive quality professional who can build a practical control framework, apply it consistently and influence experienced Underwriters. They combine sound KYC/KYB judgement with strong analytical and reporting skills, confidence in following through on remediation, and the ability to turn case-level observations into improvements across a regional operation. Essential Significant experience in underwriting, merchant due diligence, AML/KYC/KYB, onboarding, financial crime operations, quality control, quality assurance or a related risk function within financial services, payments or fintech. Practical understanding of UK and EEA due diligence requirements, with familiarity across the US, Canada, Singapore, Hong Kong, UAE, Australia and New Zealand; ability to recognise jurisdictional differences and escalate interpretation questions appropriately. Demonstrated ability to design, implement or materially improve a QC, QA, control testing or file review framework. Strong reporting and data skills, including spreadsheets, pivot tables and clear management reporting; experience with Looker dashboard or business intelligence tools is an advantage. Use of AI is a plus. Effective stakeholder management and influencing skills, including the persistence to chase remediation and escalate overdue or repeat issues appropriately. Experience delivering training or coaching based on quality control findings. Nice to Have Direct exposure to underwriting or due diligence in a merchant acquiring setting. Familiarity with case management and CRM tools,dashboard platforms. title: Compliance Manager
description: About us Plentific is pioneering real-time property operations for real-world impact. Our Software as a Service (SaaS) platform connects owners, operators, service providers and residents. We work with housing associations, local authorities, student housing, later living and build-to-rent operators, across a growing network of 1.7M+ properties and 5,000+ service providers worldwide, reaching 3M+ engaged residents. Our customers trust us with their residents’ data, their supply chains and their money. This role makes sure that trust is earned every day. Mission You'll run Plentific’s compliance programme day to day: KYC, data protection, ISO 27001, business risk and internal audit. You’ll make it practical, evidence-based and quick, using AI tools to do in hours what used to take days. What you’ll own KYC and due diligence Data protection ISO 27001 ISMS Business risk register Internal audit programme Compliance policies and training What you’ll do KYC and due diligence Run KYC checks on customers, suppliers and service providers: identity, ownership, sanctions, PEP and adverse media. Set risk-based rules for when enhanced due diligence applies, and escalate cases that need a decision. Keep KYC records complete and ready for audit or client review. Data protection Run day-to-day UK GDPR and Data Protection Act 2018 compliance: records of processing, DPIAs, retention and data subject requests. Review data processing agreements and supplier privacy terms with the legal team. Manage personal data incidents from first report to close, including the decision on whether to notify the ICO within 72 hours. Information security (ISO 27001) Maintain the ISMS with Information Security Team: Statement of Applicability, risk treatment plan, control owners and evidence, etc. Lead surveillance and recertification audits with our external certification body. Answer security and compliance questionnaires from housing association and local authority clients. Business risk and internal audit Own the business risk register. Work with risk owners to rate, treat and report risks to the General Counsel and leadership team. Plan and run an annual internal audit programme across information security, data protection and KYC, and track every finding to closure. Report on compliance status and open risks in a format leadership can act on. Policies, training and AI Keep compliance policies current, short and written so people actually read them. Run awareness training on data protection, information security and KYC. Use AI tools every day to draft policies, review questionnaires and contracts, gather audit evidence and track regulatory change. Automate the repetitive checks. Help shape how Plentific governs its own use of AI. What you’ll need 3+ years in a compliance, risk or information governance role, ideally in SaaS, fintech or another regulated tech business. Good working knowledge of KYC checks, including sanctions, PEP and beneficial ownership screening, and the tools used to run them. Hands-on experience of UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018: DPIAs, data subject requests, breach handling and supplier due diligence. Experience running or supporting an ISO 27001 ISMS through certification and surveillance audits. A track record of managing a business risk register and conducting internal audits. An ISO 27001 Internal Auditor or Lead Auditor qualification helps. A CIPP/E or CIPM certification is beneficial. AI training credentials are beneficial, such as the IAPP AIGP or an ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer course. You use AI tools daily and can give real examples of how they made your work faster or better. Clear writing, and the confidence to explain a compliance requirement to an engineer, a salesperson or a client. title: Senior National Account Manager
description: The Practical Detail Location: Hybrid | Remote Why this role matters In your first year, you will deliver an ambitious growth plan for Flora Food Group's largest customer, Bidfood, driving both sales and margin across the full P&L. This role is critical to strengthening Flora's position in the food service market by embedding a joint business plan that aligns Flora's brand priorities with Bidfood's commercial strategy. You will shape how our brands are listed, promoted, and grow within a key account that influences menus and food trends across the UK. Your work will directly impact the availability and innovation of better food in kitchens nationwide. What you'll do Own the Bidfood P&L, managing pricing, promotions, trade spend, and trade promotion management accruals to achieve sales and margin growth. Lead the joint business plan and negotiate annual trading terms to ensure Flora's brands are well positioned and invested in. Build and maintain relationships across all levels of Bidfood, from senior buyers to depot and logistics teams, to improve service and unlock commercial opportunities. Deliver new product development and innovation launches on time and at the right price, collaborating closely with culinary and new business teams. Champion the push-pull strategy by engaging Bidfood's end users—contract caterers, pubs, hotels, restaurants and Quick Serve Restaurants (QSR) — to grow brand presence and volume. Performance You will own the full P&L for the Bidfood account, driving measurable growth in sales and margin while managing trade spend within budget. Your leadership of the joint business plan will ensure alignment between Flora's brand ambitions and Bidfood's commercial goals. Success will be seen in improved brand listings, timely innovation launches, and strong trading terms that support sustainable growth. Care You will report directly to Helen Scott and collaborate with internal teams including new business, culinary, supply chain, and demand planning to ensure seamless service delivery. Externally, you will engage with multiple Bidfood functions such as buying, logistics, marketing, and category teams. Your decisions will balance commercial ambition with operational integrity, supporting a lean team environment during a period of organisational change. Passion Bidfood is at the heart of food service trends, where culinary culture is shaped. You will connect Flora's innovation pipeline directly to the chefs and kitchens that bring our products to life. Your role will influence how plant-based, indulgent, and culinary food categories evolve in the out-of-home market. Your curiosity about taste, nutrition, and functionality will drive meaningful innovation and brand growth. About you You'll bring solid food service experience, ideally managing Bidfood, Brakes, or Booker accounts, with a deep understanding of this route to market. You are commercially rigorous, confident in owning a P&L, and skilled at negotiating assertively while maintaining productive relationships. You sell on brand value, not price, and thrive in a fast-changing, lean environment. Your resilience and solution-oriented mindset help you navigate complex commercial and cultural challenges. You are genuinely interested in food culture and curious about how consumer behaviour and future food trends shape innovation. You understand that strong brands are built by anticipating what's next in taste, nutrition, and functionality, and by translating insight into meaningful consumer experiences. Where this could lead to This role typically leads to broader commercial leadership opportunities within Flora Food Group, including potential European roles as the business integrates into a larger unit. There is also scope to move into retail or new business functions. With success, you may take on direct reports and progress into senior management positions within 2 to 3 years. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Mission:</strong></p> <p>6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.</p> <p><strong>Our People:</strong></p> <p>People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. title: Director of Software Engineering
description: <p><strong> </strong><strong>The Role:</strong></p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p>Spire is making a fundamental shift in how it operates its constellation. We are moving from a model where trained operators watch dashboards and escalate to experts, to one where the system is fully autonomous, self-healing, and data intelligent. This Director will lead that transformation. You will set the technical vision, define the architecture, build and inspire the team, and personally raise the standard for what modern space operations look like. </p> <p>The old model relies on operators, escalations, manual processes, and institutional knowledge locked in the heads of a few experts. Lead initiatives to improve system observability, fault tolerance, and operational excellence across payment rails. Strong understanding of payment flows end-to-end: payment initiation, routing, reconciliation, settlement, and exception/failure handling. Experience designing and operating highly available, resilient distributed systems with robust error recovery and observability. Expertise in server-side development, ideally Kotlin or Java, with strong experience in microservices and distributed systems. Proficiency with relational databases (PostgreSQL), cloud environments (AWS, Kubernetes), and observability tooling (e.g. Grafana). Awareness of payment compliance and regulatory considerations (e.g. AML, sanctions screening, PSD2) is a plus. Understanding of safeguarding of customer funds and the impact of money movement pipelines. Strong problem-solving skills and experience owning production payment systems through incidents and operational complexity. High proficiency with AI-enhanced development tools (such as GitHub Copilot or Claude) as integrated partners for system design, documentation, and code generation. Willingness to deepen your AI fluency as Pleo scales AI adoption across engineering. We're building a culture where thoughtful AI use for delivery velocity and quality. Proven ability to structure complex engineering problems for AI collaboration, including writing precise specifications, validating generated outputs, and iterative development. A proactive drive to expand your AI fluency as we scale adoption to enhance delivery velocity and maintain high engineering quality across our organisation. A collaborative mindset and the ability to mentor and upskill teammates. title: Talent community lead
description: About the role We're hiring a Founder Community Lead to build and run the top of our founder funnel. You'll make sure that every new venture we start has strong prospective founders already engaged before it needs one. Founders Factory builds companies with corporate partners. Next year, we're aiming for 25 approved ventures in the next 12 months, and each venture needs a founder who pitches at the investment committee alongside our venture design team. You'll own our Founder Bench: a small, high-quality community of pre-vetted founders, matched to the sectors and founder profiles our ventures need. You'll fill it through sourcing and partnerships, and keep it active through four events a quarter. You'll sit in the talent team to help matching founders to ventures. What you'll do: Pipeline building: Build a steady flow of experienced founders, operators and domain experts in our partners' focus areas. Run first conversations, write short founder notes, and tag each person by founder archetype, sector, stage and availability. Share our standard founder deal with each person when they join the bench, so terms are clear before anyone commits time. Build referral routes with our portfolio founders, investors, operator communities and university spinout offices. Events: Sector founder drinks: 12–15 founders and operators around a theme from our partner's focus areas. Weekly Open studio office hours: a look at the problems we're working on, so prospective founders can see what building with us is like. Partner event: co-hosted with a feeder programme with a select group of universities Bench gathering: for founders already on the bench, to keep them engaged between ventures with managing a Slack or Whatsapp community or newsletters Engagement: Keep the founder data accurate, with every founder's archetype, sector, availability and last contact up to date in our tracker. Keep founders engaged with regular updates, intros and early sight of new themes, so they're ready when a venture starts. Give the talent team a ready longlist of 5–8 founders for each new venture within its first two weeks. Report monthly on bench size, quality, diversity and how bench founders move through to trials and selection. Who you are: 3+ years in founder-facing work: VC platform or scouting, an accelerator or founder programme, startup community building, or founding a company yourself. A network among founders and operators that you can open up quickly, and the instinct to grow it. Good judgement on founders: you can tell a strong operator from a good storyteller in a first conversation, and explain why in writing. A track record of running events that lead somewhere, from 15-person dinners to larger community nights, with clear follow-up. The ability to sell an unusual offer: building a venture we've designed with a corporate partner, rather than your own idea. Disciplined pipeline habits, keeping a CRM or tracker accurate across hundreds of relationships. A real commitment to building diverse founder pipelines, and experience doing it. Nice to have Knowledge of, or a network in, healthcare, deep tech or B2B sectors. Experience working with corporate partners or in corporate venturing. Familiarity with Airtable or similar tools. Stay close to users, every week. You're in the user conversations. You turn what you hear into what you build, and you push back when a brief isn't ready. Craft the details. Flows, interaction design, and visual polish, down to the micro-interactions and signature patterns. Obsessive about small details. You sweat the 1px difference and care about every transition and haptic. You start from the user's problem and make trade-offs explicit. You've taken on more scope, faster than your peers. Curious, self-directed, and excited by the ambiguity of building from zero. Even better if you… Have worked in fintech or wealth. How people interact with an agent, and how it earns the trust to move their money. There are few precedents to copy. Career growth. One of the first two designers, with a path to Head of Design. A team with a track record. The CEO has built two unicorns, and the team built a consumer social app used by more than 10M people every day. Competitive pay. £100K to £150K base plus equity, both set by level. Send us something you've built and shipped. We'd love to see it! title: Senior TechOps Generalist
description: Seen this advert before? That is because we are continuing to grow! We are very excited to be growing our small and efficient TechOps team at Octopus. We aren't looking for standard IT support - we are looking for an ambitious, deeply knowledgeable and experienced TechOps Generalist to join our team, to grow with the rest of the company, and ensure we are doing so in a secure and safe way. You will be a key partner in defining what TechOps is at Octopus. We will be continuing to shape this team to provide world class support to our employees, building our way out of problems with engineering firepower and undertaking transformational organisational change. We don't just "fix" things - we automate them out of existence. For us, a Generalist isn’t about knowing a little of everything, it’s a multi-disciplinary role for someone who’s deeply experienced in many facets of Enterprise IT. Think multi-domain specialist - not Jack of all trades. What is TechOps? A more modern, more lean version of a traditional enterprise IT team. We cover everything from what most people would call “1st line support” all the way up to high-level strategic planning, and everything in between. We focus on advising rather than enforcing, and give people the autonomy to work with technology to solve their problems in the way that works best for them. We’re an autonomous team who look after a wide range of technology across the business. We empower teams to do the best work they can whilst keeping things running efficiently in the background. We tackle big problems and the breadth of work is huge. Dealing with ambiguity is a key part of working in TechOps, and every day will be a new and exciting one, working on varying challenges across the company. We have a cloud-first approach to everything we do. This allows us to scale quickly and focus on things where we can add the most value. No on-prem AD here! What you'll do Provide delightful day-to-day technical support to all areas of the business, to ensure our incredible employees are able to do their job as efficiently as possible. Their problems are our problems. Troubleshoot and fix a wide range of technical issues, from laptop faults and network issues, to account provisioning failures and SSO problems. Collaborate closely with our Security team to ensure we strike the right balance between security, productivity and user experience. Continually find opportunities to automate our processes and improve the user experience. Empower our people to help themselves by designing and building self-service solutions. Monitor and maintain all the tech in our offices around the world - networks, meeting rooms, printers, digital signage, CCTV, door access control. Managing supplier relationships and the procurement process for SaaS and hardware. Lead and manage complex technical projects with multiple stakeholders from around the business. Examples of some TechOps projects include… Rollout of, and migration to, a new identity provider macOS and Windows MDM migration Rollout of a new device trust and posture compliance solution The replacement of insecure factors like SMS with phishing-resistant factors Office fit-outs, including tech like network, AV, access control etc SaaS migrations for acquisitions e.g. Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace What you'll need We’re looking for people with at least 5-7 years of solid enterprise IT experience. The technical bar is high. While we use Okta, Kandji, Kolide, Zscaler, Meraki and HiBob amongst others, we care about your understanding of the fundamentals of key SaaS tooling, but we also expect candidates to have significant experience implementing and customising these tools for Enterprise environments, so if you’ve lived in Entra and Intune? Awesome! You’ll also need: Confidence in articulating and implementing your technical ability, particularly with enterprise-level SaaS tooling, customer support and automation. The ability to do this both with your peers and novice users is vital. A team player - we don’t want people who vanish and come back with perfect, completed work. You collaborate and work transparently and can identify who can help you, or needs your help. Rich experience and examples of scripting, using APIs to automating mundane and error-prone repetitive tasks. To be comfortable with a huge amount of ambiguity and spinning a lot of plates all at the same time. Experience working with multiple teams and managing multiple stakeholders. Experience managing and deploying macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android at scale Experience administering and troubleshooting Single Sign-On (SSO) technologies such as OAuth, OIDC and SAML. Deep experience with Identity & Access Management. You should be able to explain the nuances of SAML, OIDC, and OAuth , and have hands-on experience with SCIM provisioning. Experience of designing and installing office networks - we use Cisco Meraki. A conscientious approach to everything you do and a passion for doing the right thing rather than the easy thing. Don’t think you check off every single box? We love hiring passionate people with a drive to learn. If you are an expert in some of these areas and are hungry to master the rest, get in touch and let us know where your strengths lie. Why else you'll love it here Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture . An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! We won best company to work for in 2022, on Glassdoor we were voted 50 best places to work in 2022 and our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people. We’ve also been placed in the top 10 companies for senior leadership Visit our UK perks hub - Octopus Employee Benefits This role can be either fully office based in any of our major offices in Brighton, Manchester, Leicester, Coventry or London , or a hybrid of a few days a week working remotely and office based. Our salary bandings are between £65,000 - £90,000 depending on your experience. On a call with one of our talent team, it's something we always chat through, as we genuinely want to match your experience with the right salary. We're very excited to be growing our small team. We're looking for skills and experience to help shape and define the future of not only our team, but the wider business at a global scale. If you're reading this and grinning, please apply! There are huge challenges to tackle, and we need amazing people who are keen to get stuck in. If this sounds like you then we'd love to hear from you. Are you ready for a career with us? title: Demand & Campaigns Lead, EMEA
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: We're looking for an exceptional marketing leader to drive Notion’s growth across EMEA— the team responsible for both the fuel that powers our regional go-to-market and the engine that converts it into pipeline and revenue. You'll lead a multi-disciplinary group of marketers across digital, demand, content, and campaigns, and you'll own the end-to-end system that turns regional narratives into measurable growth across markets. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Lead and develop a high-performing team - Manage and grow a cross-functional team of marketers spanning digital, demand generation, content strategy, and campaign execution. Foster a culture of craft, speed, and accountability. - Own the EMEA content and campaign narrative - Develop messaging houses grounded in real customer problems, use cases, and outcomes. Build modular, deployable content bills of materials (BOMs) — stories, assets, templates, talk tracks, proof points, and examples — that travel across channels and markets. - Lead regional demand generation - Leadership over the EMEA demand engine—across self serve and sales assist audiences, with repeatable programmes that have clear positioning, modular assets, and measurement plans that connect directly to pipeline and revenue. - Orchestrate market launches and flagship campaigns - Translate global narratives into market-ready messaging, toolkits, and channel plans. Lead the content and toolkit workstream for product launches and flagship regional campaigns. Keep cross-functional plans, assets, and timelines aligned and deployable across EMEA. - Enable the wider regional team - Partner with Country Marketing, Storytelling, Sales, and global Product Marketing to ensure consistent storytelling, proof points, and talk tracks across every market and channel. Your team's output is what others build from. - Scale with AI - Build and apply AI-driven workflows to accelerate research, drafting, localisation, and asset iteration at speed — without sacrificing accuracy or customer relevance. Model this capability for the broader team. - Measure and sharpen - Use funnel insights — engagement data, customer feedback, and business metrics — to continuously refine messaging, content, and programmes. Report on what's working and make the case for change when it isn't. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - 12+ years in B2B marketing — with meaningful time owning both content/narrative and demand generation in a high-growth or enterprise SaaS environment. - Proven people leadership — experience building, managing, and developing multi-disciplinary marketing teams. You know how to hire for craft and lead through ambiguity. - Narrative and content mastery — you can write a compelling messaging house, build a scalable toolkit, and coach others to do the same. Customer empathy is instinctive, not a checklist item. - Demand generation depth — hands-on experience running and optimising paid, email, webinar, and outbound programmes, with a strong grasp of funnel metrics and revenue attribution. - AI fluency — you actively use AI tools to accelerate your work and can design workflows for your team to do the same. Not a curiosity — an active working practice. - EMEA market knowledge — experience running multi-market programmes across EMEA with an understanding of localisation needs, cultural nuance, and go-to-market variation across the region. - Cross-functional influence — able to align and work effectively across global and regional stakeholders in Sales, Product Marketing, Comms, and Country teams — without always having formal authority. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. We work alongside our first line credit teams who design the products, decide who to lend to, set underwriting policy, identify customers who need help, manage the portfolio and report and measure credit risk.</p> <p>Within CIF, we are scaling up our Forecasting modelling and execution team to support the enhancement of modelling standards across Finance. The role holder will have the opportunity to lead a ‘consultancy style’ centre of excellence providing thought leadership on the methodological design and regulatory compliance assessment on all Financial forecasting models that feed the banks’ budgeting and stress-testing activities. This will expand to hands-on delivery of model developments, where appropriate. </p> <p>Strong data and analytical skills are a must, as is experience in financial modelling and coding (Python and SQL preferred). Experience working in regulatory stress testing exercises (such as ICAAP or EBA Stress-testing) is highly desirable but not essential. </p> <p>We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies (note we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all them):</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://cloud.google.com/">Google Cloud Platform</a> for all of our analytics infrastructure</li> <li><a href="https://www.getdbt.com/">dbt</a> and<a href="https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/"><strong> </strong>BigQuery SQL</a> for our data modelling and warehousing</li> <li>Python for data science and predictive modelling and data visualisation (via streamlit)</li> <li>Anaplan for model implementation</li> <li>Github for version control</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Assisting with continuous improvement of forecasting models via individual delivery or through others</li> <li>Development of best practices for financial modelling across Monzo</li> <li>Presenting forecast model results to senior management</li> <li>Close collaboration with portfolio strategy, model validation, finance and external audit teams</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a background in financial forecast modelling or execution</li> <li>You have strong analytical skills and a track record of using these to deliver technical projects</li> <li>You have a solid technical toolkit. SQL and Python are our desired coding languages but experience in SAS/R will be considered. A data visualisation tool (such as Streamlit or Looker) is a plus</li> <li>You can convey problems and solutions using clear and simple language, both written and verbal (see <a href="https://monzo.com/tone-of-voice/">Monzo’s tone of voice</a> guide). This is particularly important for communicating complex issues and priorities to non-experts</li> <li>You're impact driven and eager to have a real positive impact on the company, our products, our users and your team-mates</li> <li>You have a self-starter mindset<em>;</em> you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so</li> <li>You're a team player<em> </em>whom your colleagues can rely on</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>Initial call with a member of the Forecasting team</li> <li>Technical modelling interview </li> <li>Values and collaboration behavioural interview</li> <li>A live case study problem solving interview</li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £79,000 to £106,800 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">benefits</a>  </p> <p>📍 London (one day a week)</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">here</a></p> <p> </p> <p><span class="notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">#LI-JH1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>
